grooming.title: Grooming & Spa
grooming.subtitle: Book a verified groomer, or grow your grooming business, on the same platform that looks after your pet’s health.

owners.title: For pet parents
owners.lede: Salon, spa and at-home grooming from businesses we have actually checked.

verified.title: Verified professionals
verified.desc: Every business is reviewed and approved before it can take a booking. You see legal name, GSTIN and contact details up front.

mobile.title: At-home grooming
mobile.desc: Filter for mobile groomers who come to your door, no carrier, no car, no stressed pet.

slots.title: Real availability
slots.desc: Live slots from the groomer’s own diary and station capacity. If you can pick it, it is genuinely free.

passport.title: Grooming Passport
passport.desc: Every visit builds a per-pet record: full history plus a non-medical S.C.E.N.T. wellness trend you can show your vet.

escalation.title: A second pair of eyes
escalation.desc: Groomers see your pet up close. Spot a lump, a limp or a skin problem and they raise a safety flag you can turn into a vet consult in a tap.

money.title: Clear money
money.desc: Prices and deposits shown before you book. Cancel inside the policy window and refunds go back to source, or to your wallet if you prefer.

providers.title: For grooming & spa businesses
providers.lede: Salons, mobile groomers and pet spas: run the whole operation, not just the listing.

listing.title: Free to list
listing.desc: No signup fee and no monthly charge. Create your profile, add services and pricing, and go live once verified.

diary.title: A diary that holds
diary.desc: Set working hours, per-day overrides and blocked slots, and how many pets you can handle at once. Double-booking is impossible by design.

acceptance.title: You accept the work
acceptance.desc: Bookings come to you to accept or decline first. Nothing lands in your diary that you did not agree to.

earnings.title: Earnings you can see
earnings.desc: Every order shows gross, commission and net. Watch it move from clearing to available, then withdraw to your bank or wallet.

invoicing.title: GST invoicing built in
invoicing.desc: Compliant invoices and credit notes are generated for you, including deposits, extras and balance-due amounts.

disputes.title: Fair dispute handling
disputes.desc: If a customer raises an issue you get to respond, with a documented decision and a clear refund trail.

providers.note: Register in minutes. Verification is per business, so you can set up your profile while the review is in progress.

moat.title: Grooming that is connected to real veterinary care
moat.desc: A standalone grooming app ends at the appointment. Here, a groomer who spots something concerning raises a safety escalation, and you can book a licensed vet on the same platform, with the pet’s grooming history already attached. Groomers escalate. They never diagnose or prescribe. That boundary is enforced in the product, not just in policy.
